Hi Emily —

Really glad we connected — thanks for the clear list. Quick recap and concrete next steps from my side:  

Recap (short):
- Redwood can enter into a BAA. We maintain a standard BAA template that our legal team can adapt for specific requests.
- PHI-supporting deployments: we do NOT recommend using the hosted multi-tenant Redwood API for PHI. For workloads that will touch PHI, the eligible deployment modes are: 
  * Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with customer isolation)
  * Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem package for air-gapped/regulatory needs)
Both Dedicated and Private can be covered under a BAA and allow control of network boundaries and key management.
- Controls & constraints to note: data retention of request logs can be configured per-customer; by default we keep traces for 30 days but on PHI contracts we can negotiate retention and redaction policies. Model-level telemetry (e.g., token traces) can be disabled or routed to customer-owned storage.

Next steps (actions & owners):
1) I will share our SOC 2 summary and BAA template with this thread (attached) — Marissa, Neha, copying you to help with a concise SOC/controls note for Everwell. (action: Karthik)
2) Emily / Procurement: please confirm whether you prefer the questionnaire returned as an XLSX or in a portal. If XLSX, we will upload a completed copy back to your secure file share. (action: Everwell)
3) Marissa/Neha: please review Everwell's vendor questionnaire and indicate any missing evidence points and an estimated completion date. (action: Marissa/Neha)

Timelines: we can get a completed SOC2 summary and BAA template to you within 24 business hours. Full SOC 2 Type II report copies typically require an NDA; we'll note that in our reply.

I hope this helps — sending the attachments now.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Hi Emily / Karthik —

Attaching a brief SOC 2 summary and our current BAA template for review. High-level answers below:  

- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II coverage through 2026; we are issuing a summary PDF for initial review. Full report access requires a mutual NDA — we can route that to procurement/legal.
- BAA: We will sign a standard BAA. Our template is attached; legal has highlighted two items they typically negotiate (data return/destruction and subprocessor list).
- Eligible hosting for PHI: Confirming Karthik's note — Hosted multi-tenant API is not an approved PHI hosting mode. Approved options are Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). Dedicated supports customer-controlled networking and optional BYOK for key management; Private supports stricter isolation and air-gapped deployments.
- Log & telemetry handling: For PHI contracts we can: disable model debug traces, route logs to the customer's S3 in their account (for Dedicated/Private), and set retention to 0/30/90 days as negotiated.

Timeline: SOC summary + BAA template sent now. If Everwell would like legal-to-legal conversation, please introduce your counsel and we will coordinate.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Type2-2026-summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA-template.docx

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
